# Leruso Eyewear

> Independent luxury optician and eyewear boutique at Bathurst & Steeles (7131 Bathurst St, Unit 105, Thornhill, ON L4J 7Z1, inside HealthRise Medical Centre), serving Toronto, North York, Vaughan and Richmond Hill. Designer eyeglasses and sunglasses, eye exams, contact lenses and one-on-one frame styling. All insurance plans accepted with direct billing. 5.0 on Google with 89 reviews.

## About
- One-on-one service: clients deal with the same licensed optician every visit, who remembers their prescription and style.
- An edited selection of optical and sun frames from 16 luxury houses: Dior, Gucci, Tom Ford, Saint Laurent, Jacques Marie Mage, Loewe, Givenchy, Versace, Montblanc, Chopard, Leisure Society, Zilli, Dunhill, Silhouette, ic! berlin and Ray-Ban.
- Rare pieces: holds two of the twenty Leisure Society x Daniel Sturridge "Solana" frames (18K and 24K gold, numbered limited edition).
- Prescription lenses fitted by a licensed optician, including Transitions lenses in eight colours, Essilor Varilux progressives and thin high-index lenses.

## Services
- Eye exams: comprehensive, unhurried exams with the findings explained.
- Contact lenses: fittings, trials and refills (daily, two-week, monthly and specialty lenses).
- Lenses and fitting: precise measurements and adjustments until the frame sits right.
- Insurance: all plans accepted, billed directly to the insurer.

## Contact and hours
- Phone: (905) 881-4123
- Book an exam or fitting: https://book.lerusoeyewear.com
- Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 10:00-6:00; Wed, Fri 11:00-5:00; Sat 11:00-3:00; Sun closed. Appointments and walk-ins welcome.
